build_mllama_batch: build a MllamaCausalLMBatch from protobuf requests using from_pb_processor with a tokenizer and processor
concatenate_mllama_batches: concatenate multiple MllamaCausalLMBatch instances merging cross attention states and image indices
filter_mllama_batch: filter a MllamaCausalLMBatch by request ids updating image indices and cross attention states
tokenize_mllama_inputs: tokenize batched text and image inputs into input ids and image tensors for MllamaCausalLMBatch
forward_mllama_model: run a forward pass on MllamaCausalLM with a batch supporting speculative decoding and CUDA graphs
